name: gate_woods_fall
source_description: Rustic woodland access gate leaf built from irregular split chestnut vertical staves within a simple stout weathered timber rectangle, two crossrails and one diagonal brace. Uneven stave tops but controlled rectangular outer dimensions, spaced open gaps, damp grey brown wood, hand forged strap hinges on the left edge. Plausible forestry enclosure, restrained small lichen patches, no surrounding trees.
